newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-S&P puts Pasminco on negative watch.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-S&P puts Pasminco on negative watch.

text.p: Standard and Poor's Corp said on Friday it had placed mining group Pasminco Ltd, now rated BBB-minus, on negative watch after the announcement that it will buy the Century zinc project from RTZ-CRA.
Standard and Poor's also said it has placed the A-3 short-term rating on Pasminco Finance Ltd guaranteed promissory note programme on negative watch.
The ratings agency said it expected Pasminco to fund the A$345 million acquisition with debt and equity and to incur development costs of about A$1 billion over three years.

"In a volatile base metals market, an increased level of gearing in combination with the long lead time before the Century deposit is cash positive, limits Pasminco's financial flexibility and potentially could weaken its prudential framework," S&P said. -- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
